recipe.visualDefinition: A central anthropomorphic fish character playing a guitar and holding a drink, set within a red diamond frame filled with bubbles, topped by a complex geometric logo featuring concentric circles and horizontal speed lines against a solid black background.
coreVisualRelationships: The character is contained within a tilted square (diamond) frame.
The geometric logo sits atop the diamond, acting as a crown.
Horizontal speed lines intersect the logo and extend outward.
A high-contrast relationship between the vibrant central illustration and the deep black negative space.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The character occupies the center of the diamond frame, which is centered horizontally in the lower two-thirds of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular logo at the top center serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top logo, follows the vertical axis down into the character, and is directed outward by the horizontal speed lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounds the central diamond and logo, focusing all attention on the core graphic.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan, Yellow, and Gold (Logo and character details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation within the central graphic elements contrasted against a zero-value black background.

letterConstructionRules: Display text is wide, geometric, and uppercase.
Logo text uses thick, rounded, 3D-extruded forms.
Secondary script is fluid and slanted.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'ARS' acronym is integrated into the concentric circle graphic with heavy drop shadows and metallic gradients.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, modern sans-serif for metadata paired with a highly stylized, illustrative 3D logo font.
graphicDevices: Horizontal speed lines with rainbow gradients

preserve: The wide tracking of the top text
The 3D extrusion of the central logo letters

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric feel of the top display text.
Provides the base for the rounded, tubular logo lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black background. In the center, place a red diamond frame filled with a dense pattern of airbrushed pink and white bubbles. Inside the diamond, illustrate a green anthropomorphic fish wearing a hat, playing a guitar, and holding a glass. Above the diamond, place a graphic consisting of concentric circles and horizontal lines with rainbow gradients.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the display text at the very top in a wide white sans-serif. Create a custom 3D logo using the acronym 'ARS' inside the concentric circles, applying a yellow gradient and heavy black outlines.

verificationChecks: Is the diamond frame tilted at 45 degrees?
Does the logo feature horizontal speed lines extending to the sides?
Is the background texture composed of airbrushed bubbles?
Is the overall aesthetic consistent with late 70s airbrush art?

adjustableVariables: Number of concentric circles in the logo
Gradient colors on the speed lines
mustRedesign: Specific band name and album title text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the character is centered within the diamond.
Verify the horizontal lines are perfectly parallel.
Check that the 3D extrusion on the logo letters is consistent.
Confirm the bubble texture has varying sizes and highlights.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central character in a geometric frame with a heavy 3D logo and horizontal speed lines against a dark void.
